items.title: Jim Robinson Interview, 1961-07-13
items.q: I wasn't playing then, you know... He played with a boy, a fella called Zooey Selden.

ctx.x: Sidney Veen. Sidney Veen. All them fellas, man, them fellas, really good clarinet players. I wasn't playing then, you know. Really good clarinet players. Yeah. What did Sidney Veen, who did Sidney Veen play with? He just played a... He played with a boy, a fella called Zooey Selden. He got killed, you know. Zooey Selden. Zooey Selden, yeah, he got killed. What did he play? Trumpet.
I never heard much about that band, I don't think. Who was in the band other than Sidney Veen and Zooey? One of the time they had the band then.
